CONSULTING AGREEMENT

This Consulting Agreement (the “Agreement”) is entered into as of {{effectiveDate}} (the “Effective Date”) by and between {{partyA.name}}, {{partyA.entityType}} (“Company”), and {{partyB.name}}, {{partyB.entityType}} (“Consultant”). Company and Consultant are each a “Party” and together the “Parties.”

1. Services

Consultant will provide the following advisory services (the “Services”): {{services}}. Consultant will devote {{hoursPerMonth}} to the Services and will be reasonably available for scheduled meetings.

2. Term

This Agreement begins on {{startDate}} and continues for {{termMonths}} months, renewing month to month thereafter until terminated.

3. Fees

Company will pay Consultant {{retainer}}. Payment terms: {{paymentTerms}}. Company will reimburse pre-approved, reasonable out-of-pocket expenses on presentation of receipts.

4. Independent Contractor

Consultant is an independent contractor, not an employee, agent or partner of Company, and has no authority to bind Company. Consultant is responsible for all taxes and statutory contributions on the fees paid under this Agreement, and is not eligible for Company employee benefits.

5. Confidentiality

Consultant will hold Company’s non-public information in confidence, use it only to perform the Services, and not disclose it. This obligation survives termination indefinitely for trade secrets and for three years otherwise.

6. Intellectual Property

Consultant assigns to Company all right, title and interest in any work product, advice, materials, inventions and improvements created in performing the Services. Consultant retains its pre-existing materials and general know-how, and grants Company a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use them as embodied in the work product.

7. No Conflict

Consultant represents that performing the Services does not conflict with any obligation it owes to a third party. Consultant will disclose in writing any engagement with a direct competitor of Company arising during the term.

8. Non-Solicitation

During the term and for twelve months afterwards, Consultant will not solicit for employment any Company employee with whom Consultant worked in connection with the Services.

9. Termination

Either Party may terminate on {{noticeDays}} days’ written notice, or immediately for material breach uncured 10 days after written notice. On termination Company pays for Services performed through the termination date, and Consultant returns Company materials and delivers work product in progress. Sections 5, 6 and 8 survive.

10. Limitation of Liability

Neither Party is liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages. Consultant’s aggregate liability is limited to the fees paid in the twelve months preceding the claim, except for breach of confidentiality or wilful misconduct.

11. Not Advice of a Regulated Kind

Unless the Services expressly say otherwise, Consultant does not provide legal, tax, accounting, medical or investment advice, and Company will obtain its own professional advice on those matters.

Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governingLaw}}, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules.

Entire Agreement

This Agreement is the entire agreement between the Parties on its subject matter and supersedes all prior discussions. It may be amended only in a writing signed by both Parties. It may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which is an original.

Execution

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
